description: Werknummer 31403, built at Kazan and registered in the DDR on 4 May 1973. Interflug Il-62 named Lady Agnes, landed on a 900 m grass strip at Stölln in October 1989 and preserved there ever since; the forward fuselage houses a Lilienthal exhibition and the aircraft has been a registry office since 1991; overhauled in 2018 and protected as a monument.
